stage_47_page_table_snapshot.guard: Builds a low identity TTBR0 map from the currently active old-TTBR1 mappings, independently of the candidate root, checks read/write translations and walked execute permissions, then takes and returns from BRK #0xb712 before the TTBR1 helper. On success, a fault in the helper uses the physical alias vector/state/stack; TTBR0 and VBAR are restored after helper return. Mapping or self-test failure restores the old roots and falls back to the original vector path.
